Hi Team Institute Of Martial Arts,

I noticed your institute has strong 4.3★ reviews near Ashok Rajpath in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and trial inquiries.

Maine aapke martial arts institute ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense classes, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ima

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Institute Of Martial Arts team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for Ashok Rajpath, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact classes, actual photos aur schedule integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
